name: Last Light
description: The flagship. A survivor-like across three nights: steer a lantern spirit with the joystick while its weapons fire on their own. Gems level you up: the night freezes while you tap the upgrade you want. Each night ends with a boss.

name: Sundown Herd
description: Five foals have wandered off across the valley. Ride out, find them by their sparkle and lead them home in a line behind you before the sun sets. After dusk the wolves come out: if one reaches you, the foals bolt.

name: Moonward
description: A bouncing climb from a sunset meadow to the moon. The spark bounces by itself; hold it and slide to steer onto the next platform. Springs launch you, grey platforms crumble, and the night rises from below, faster and faster.

name: Meteor Run
description: Drag a ship to dodge three escalating waves of meteors. 3 lives; ride out the whole storm to win.

name: Bubble Storm
description: Three sizes of bubbles rise from the bottom. Tap to pop (+1). Let one reach the top and it costs you (-1). Reach 30 to win, -10 to lose.

name: Reaction Test
description: Wait for the prompt to flip to NOW, then tap -- ten clean taps win. Tap too early and it is a strike; three strikes out.

name: Lucky Slots
description: Bet a slot, then SPIN -- three balls drop. The gold jackpot ball in your slot is the big win, the silver one a smaller win; miss both and bust.

name: Dungeon Escape
description: Three sequential dungeons -- drag your hero past chasing guards, grab the key to open the door, reach the exit. Clear all three.

name: Boss Duel
description: Weave a puck into the boss to chip its HP while dodging its telegraphed, homing attacks. One-finger drag.

name: Minesweeper
description: Three sequential 5x5 boards. Tap tiles to uncover their mine counts; clear 20 to advance. Clear all three boards to win.

name: Grid Run
description: Grid mode: three escalating mazes back-to-back. Steer the cell-stepping runner past the guards to each exit; clear all three to win.

name: Snake
description: Grid mode: classic snake. Steer the head to eat 8 foods -- it grows one segment per food. Bite your own tail and it is over.

name: Pac-Man
description: Grid mode: steer Pac through a maze, eat all 34 dots, dodge three ghosts. Power pellets turn the ghosts scared. 3 lives.

name: Tower Defense
description: Tap enemies marching a snaking path to your base. Grunts drop in one tap, brutes in three. Three escalating waves; hold the base or lose 5 lives.

name: Brick Breaker
description: Drag the paddle, bounce the ball, break the bricks. Stage 1 is soft bricks; stage 2 is stone (two hits each). Drop the ball and the run ends.

name: Grid Dungeon
description: Grid mode crawl: three rooms with walls. Steer the hero, grab two keys to open the doors, scoop the gold, reach the exit. Two patrolling guards -- mind the marked danger lanes.

name: Plinko
description: Tap the gold strip to drop a ball through a peg field. Five floor slots score 100/250/500/250/100 -- the middle is the jackpot. Hit 1500 to win.

name: Space Invaders
description: A 5x6 formation marches sideways and steps down each pass. Drag the ship; it fires on its own. Clear every invader before any reach the bottom.

name: Pinball-lite
description: Two tap-flippers at the bottom kick the ball back into the bumper field. Three bumpers, gravity-driven ball, drop between the flippers and you lose a life.

name: Platformer
description: Drag the hero left and right; tap LEFT or RIGHT pads to leap up-and-sideways. Gravity pulls you down; the orange ledges are one-way (jump through from below, land on from above). Reach the gold flag at the top.

name: Tetris
description: Real Tetris on the engine: seven tetrominos drop into a 10x20 board; LEFT/RIGHT shift, ROTATE turns, DROP soft-drops. Clear 10 lines to win.

name: Sokoban
description: Grid-puzzle classic: push three brown boxes onto the gold target tiles. Boxes only move if the cell behind is empty; walls and other boxes cancel the push.
Swipe LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN to slide all tiles. Equal-value tiles merge into a doubled tile; a new tile drops on an empty cell after every swipe. Reach 128 to win.

name: Long Run
description: Side-scroller: drag the runner up and down to dodge red barriers while the camera scrolls across a 5-screen-wide world. Reach the gold flag at the far east end.

name: Open World
description: Top-down explorer: drag the hero anywhere on a 2x2 world. The camera follows in both axes. Pick up all five gold coins to win.

name: Star Forager
description: Joystick demo: fly a scout with the virtual analog stick, scoop all 8 gold orbs, and dodge two lane-sweeping drones. 3 lives.
